{{Top|leg}}
The '''Musical Rocks''', known as '''''Queee-ha''''' in [[Gacerian (language)|Gacerian]], were a collection of boulders on the [[Plateau of Dreams]], located on the [[Elto]] continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gacerian]]. As the wind blew through the boulders, it produced eerie musics. [[Gacerite]]s mediated at the Musical Rocks, and it was the closest place the Gacerites had to a religious shrine.
